author: birdybro (GitHub; MiSTer contributor)
what_it_is: birdybro's own MiSTer FDS save of Akuu Senki Raijin, from a zip of their whole MiSTer saves folder (file dated 2021-09-13).
note: MiSTer NES core FDS save: 16 zero bytes, then the whole disk image as the core holds it (each side 65500 bytes, fwNES layout without the 16-byte 'FDS\x1a' header), then padding to a 512-byte multiple (2 sides: 16 + 131000 + 56 = 131072). The disk sides start at offset 0x10. Matches NES.sv: save_sz = rom_sz[17:9] sectors read from SDRAM 0x3C0000, disk loaded at 0x3C0010. 2021 build difference: the 56 padding bytes at 0x1FFC8 hold stale memory (another disk's header), not zeros. Bytes 0x10..0x1FFC7 differ from the No-Intro image in 6 bytes on side A (0xbcf8-0xbcfd).
